The character is standing in the battlefield wearing a jacket and a futuristic transformation belt. He presses the glowing red core on the belt with his hand. The belt begins emitting powerful energy and sparks.

As the belt activates, the character's eyes begin glowing bright yellow with powerful energy. Light pulses through his body and small sparks appear around him.

A glowing energy core appears on the chest. Dark metallic armor begins forming from the chest outward, with mechanical plates assembling and sliding together. The armor has dark blue metallic textures with glowing red lava-like energy cracks running through the suit. 

 

Scene 4 — Half Face Transformation 

The armor spreads upward from the chest and shoulder toward one side of the face, forming half of a futuristic armored helmet while the other half of the face remains human and visible. The glowing energy lines pulse through the armor. 

 

Scene 5 — Full Body Armor Formation 

The armor continues assembling across the body from chest → shoulders → arms → waist → legs with realistic mechanical movements and glowing energy veins. The character’s face remains partially visible until the final moment. 

 

Final Helmet Formation 

At the final stage, the helmet fully closes over the face forming a powerful futuristic dark warrior helmet with glowing orange-red eyes and sharp horn-like edges, matching the armor design. 

 

Final Scene 

The character stands fully transformed into a powerful armored warrior with dark blue metallic armor and glowing red lava energy lines, while meteors continue falling behind him and fire burns across the battlefield.
